correctness.rationale: Seriality makes successor sets nonempty. Transitivity and right-Euclideanness force S(v)=S(u) on uRv, hence distinct successor sets disjoint; their fibers partition W and each contains its nonempty reflexive set, giving a bijection with partitions carrying nonempty marked subsets in each block. Uniform ordinary set partition plus independent fair Bernoulli vertex marks, conditioned on at least one mark in every block, gives exactly uniform decorated partitions. The number of blocks K_n in a uniform ordinary partition satisfies E K_n=o(n): for q=floor(n/log n), onto-function count yields Bell lower log B_n >= n log n-n log log n-O(n), whereas partitions with >=epsilon n blocks have numerator at most n^{n+1}/ceil(epsilon n)!; their ratio decays. Thus P(A)>=2^{-E K}=exp(-o(n)). Conditional on precisely m~alpha n marks, on K<=2 E K+1 (partition probability >=1/2), requiring fixed representatives to be marked costs at worst (alpha/2)^K=exp(-o(n)). So P(M=m)=Bin(n,m)2^-n P(A|Z=m)/P(A), giving binomial rate I(alpha) by Stirling and Chernoff matching tails with a single interior m. Independent exact recurrence for T(n,m) matched decorated partitions through n=11, finite corroboration only. Endpoints alpha=0,1 and CLT/local relative-error not claimed.
